title: Cross-task softmax classification on fashion / usps (P2 score on LR probs)

figures.caption: Fig. Classification accuracy vs labeled budget on fashion and usps; solid lines = mean over 20 paired seeds, shaded band = 95% paired-t CI.
Fig. 5. Budget-ACC curves on the overlapping binary task (Fashion T-shirt vs Shirt). P2_NoExploration (pink) exceeds P2_Full at every budget point; the gap widens from ~1pp at 5% to ~3pp at 30%.

results: Paradigm transfer: treating softmax outputs as the P2 membership U, the KL-robust score plus h_i=||u_i-u_bar||_1 ranks unlabeled points. On fashion at the 10% budget the four-method mean accuracy is P2_Full=0.727, P2_NoExploration=0.717, Random=0.722, Entropy=0.694 (20 paired seeds, 95% CI in add5_clf_summary.csv). Curves over 5/10/15/20% are shown for fashion and usps. S5 tight-budget binary add-on (T-shirt vs Shirt, N=2000): at 10% budget the mean accuracy is P2_Full=0.785, P2_NoExploration=0.799, Random=0.790, Entropy=0.821 (20 paired seeds, 10 budget points from 1% to 30%). On the overlapping binary task (Fashion T-shirt vs Shirt, logistic-regression backend), P2_NoExploration exceeds P2_Full at every budget point: +1.4pp at 10% (0.799 vs 0.785) and +3.2pp at 30% (0.818 vs 0.786). Full saturates after 15% while NoExploration keeps rising, consistent with the pathology being strongest under tight budgets. Entropy (uncertainty baseline) ranks first overall and is reported as a reference.
conclusion: Exploratory/post-hoc cross-task check: the P2 acquisition formula is mechanical and carries over to the classification backend, but this is NOT a confirmatory clustering result; report it as a robustness probe with the attached paired CIs and Holm-adjusted p-values.
annotations: backend = SGDClassifier(loss='log_loss', max_iter=30) for speed on the 256-dim pool
U = softmax predict_proba; P2 score w^rob + rho*||u-u_bar||_1 reused
batched vectorized KL-DRO gain (gamma Dirichlet, 40-pt log tau grid)
fixed lam_red=0.01 (data-dependent beta~0.009; n x n eigendecomp skipped under multi-worker memory pressure)
cosine redundancy computed row-wise (no dense n x n matrix)
local pkl subsamples: fashion N=5000 d=50, usps N=5000 d=256; c=10
S5 add-on: fashion binary T-shirt/top(0) vs Shirt(6), N=2000, 2-class
backend LogisticRegression(lbfgs, max_iter=1000) for the binary task
10-class fashion/usps results are exploratory; 2-class tight-budget is the primary S5 result
